content.rationale: Verification is where the assembled file meets its checker: run `quint typecheck specs/markers/check.qnt && quint verify specs/markers/check.qnt --main=markers --invariant=TypeOK,AtKnown,Window --max-steps=10` — grammar plus types first, then bounded-exhaustive invariants over all traces to the bound. Runs green at placement and whenever any section changes (verify needs a JDK for its Apalache backend; typecheck does not).
